data.one_liner: Widget to draw line graphs with customizable features and labels
data.what_it_does: Provides a LineGraph widget that plots multiple data series on a line chart. Features include custom colors, opacity, axis labels, and optional descriptions for each series.
use_when: You need a simple line chart without external dependencies
You want to display multiple series with titles and colors
You prefer a widget that handles layout and labeling automatically
avoid_when: You need advanced chart features like tooltips, zoom, or animations
You require integration with charting libraries that support more chart types
You need a highly customizable or performance‑critical chart implementation
strengths: Easy to use API with required properties
Supports multiple series with individual colors and titles
Customizable axis labels and description area
weaknesses: No support for bar, pie, or other chart types
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import the package; no additional setup required

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: More features, including tooltips, animations, and multiple chart types

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Rich charting library with extensive customization and performance optimizations

data.minimal_example:
LineGraph(
  features: [
    Feature(title: "Water", color: Colors.blue, data: [0.2, 0.8, 1, 0.7, 0.6]),
    Feature(title: "Exercise", color: Colors.pink, data: [1, 0.8, 0.6, 0.7, 0.3]),
  ],
  size: Size(320, 400),
  labelX: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri'],
  labelY: ['0%', '20%', '40%', '60%', '80%'],
  showDescription: true,
)
